newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Physician Reliance rated neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Physician Reliance rated neutral.

text.p: --Vector Securities International Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Physician Reliance Network with a neutral rating.
--"We do believe the stock offers long-term investment value, but could trade sideways for two to three quarters and (we) would wait to initiate positions," analyst Margot Durow noted in a report.
--Vector's earnings per share estimates for the company are for $0.43 in 1996, $0.45 in 1997 and $0.54 in 1998.
--Physician Reliance Network operates 16 integrated cancer centers in Texas and one in New Mexico. Its stock was trading at 7-5/8, off 1/4.
